x0,y0,x1,y1=445,300,585,435
p=im[y0:y1,x0:x1]
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(p,cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
H,S,V=cv2.split(hsv)
# weighted membership green yellow H 25-55 OpenCV, saturation
ah=np.clip((H.astype(float)-20)/10,0,1)*np.clip((65-H.astype(float))/15,0,1)
aS=np.clip((S.astype(float)-35)/90,0,1)
aV=np.clip((V.astype(float)-80)/80,0,1)
a=ah*aS*aV
# constrain radial
Y,X=np.ogrid[:p.shape[0],:p.shape[1]]
r=np.sqrt(((X-70)/59)**2+((Y-65)/58)**2)

a=cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),1.3)

# checker
bg=np.indices(p.shape[:2]).sum(0)//10%2*80+80
out=(p*a[...,None]+bg[...,None]*(1-a[...,None])).astype(np.uint8)
